scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Talk to the NPC in the Prontera Church "Sister Linus". Bring 30 Holy Water and 20 Blue Gemstones to her, although it's recommended that you bring 10 extra Blue Gemstones .
1.short_ru: У Sister Linus подготовьте 30 Holy Water и 20 Blue Gemstones; ещё 10 Blue Gemstones рекомендованы.
1.short_en: Prepare 30 Holy Water and 20 Blue Gemstones for Sister Linus; 10 extra Blue Gemstones are recommended.
1.full_ru: Поговорите с Sister Linus в Prontera Church. Принесите 30 Holy Water и 20 Blue Gemstones; источник рекомендует взять ещё 10 Blue Gemstones. Необходимое умение: Resurrection Level 1.
1.full_en: Talk to the NPC in the Prontera Church "Sister Linus". Bring 30 Holy Water and 20 Blue Gemstones to her, although it's recommended that you bring 10 extra Blue Gemstones . Skill Requirements: Resurrection Level 1

items.condition: Recommended extra stock above the required twenty, not an additional compulsory fee.

2.original_instruction: After bringing her the required items, she will attempt to teach you Redemptio . The chance of this succeeding is random, and each attempt uses 1 Holy Water and 1 Blue Gemstone . Once you succeed, you'll have learned the skill.
2.short_ru: Повторяйте обучение у Sister Linus до успеха: за попытку расходуются 1 Holy Water и 1 Blue Gemstone.
2.short_en: Repeat Sister Linus's teaching until success: each attempt consumes 1 Holy Water and 1 Blue Gemstone.
2.full_ru: Когда вы принесёте нужные предметы, она попробует обучить вас Redemptio. Успех случаен; каждая попытка расходует 1 Holy Water и 1 Blue Gemstone. После успешной попытки умение будет изучено.
2.full_en: After bringing her the required items, she will attempt to teach you Redemptio . The chance of this succeeding is random, and each attempt uses 1 Holy Water and 1 Blue Gemstone . Once you succeed, you'll have learned the skill.

reviews.detail: Header calls 30 Holy Water/20 Blue Gemstones consumed; body says bring that stock, recommends ten extra gems and explicitly spends one water plus one gem per attempt. Preserve the conflict as source summaries, not a second 30/20 charge. Required stock, optional extra stock and variable per-attempt consumption are separate facts; chance and total attempts remain unknown.

Resurrection Level 1 is restored into the full step text from the source header without guessing a numeric Skill ID. Sister Linus is scoped independently from Sister Cecelia and other church actors. No coordinates are printed.
